6144.o: Travel to the Undercity and speak with Varimathras.

6145.o: Return to Eastern Plaguelands and track down the Crimson Courier. Kill the Courier and recover the Grand Crusader’s Command.$B$BTake the command to Nathanos Blightcaller for further instruction.

6146.o: Travel to Tyr’s Hand, southeast of the Marris Stead. Once there, take a bite of the Rotten Apple. While under the guise of the Scarlet Crusade, deliver the Grand Crusader’s Command to Crusader Lord Valdelmar.

6147.o: Return to Nathanos Blightcaller with the new information.$B

6148.o: The Scarlet Crusade is on the move. Somewhere along the road from Tyr’s Hand to Stratholme you will find the Oracle, Demetria, and her entourage. Hunt her down and slay her. Return to Nathanos Blightcaller should you succeed.

6161.o: Find Rackmore’s Silver Key.  Find Rackmore’s Golden Key.  Find and open Rackmore’s Chest.

6162.o: Kill Overlord Ror and return his claw to Dreka’Sur at Bloodvenom Post in Felwood.

6163.o: Travel to Stratholme and slay Ramstein the Gorger. Take his head as a souvenir for Nathanos.

6164.o: Bring Augustus’ Receipt Book to Augustus the Touched in Terrordale.

6181.o: Bring Lewis’ Note to Thor the gryphon master.

6182.o: Speak with Mathias Shaw in Old Town Stormwind. He resides in the Barracks.

6183.o: Speak with Mathias Shaw again if you wish to accept his task.

6184.o: Travel to Chillwind Camp in the Western Plaguelands and meet up with your contact, Flint Shadowmore.$B

6185.o: Scour the Eastern Plaguelands for clues as to the "Blightcaller" and the missing SI:7 agents. If you find any SI:7 Insignias, return them to Flint Shadowmore at Chillwind Camp.

6186.o: Return to Stormwind and inform Highlord Bolvar Fordragon of the fate of Nathanos Marris.

6187.o: Assemble an army and travel to the Eastern Plaguelands. Launch a full assault on Nathanos Blightcaller and any Horde filth that may attempt to protect him.$B$BKeep your wits about you, $N. The Horde will defend the ranger lord with their very lives.

6261.o: Bring Osric’s Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.

6281.o: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Thor, then bring Lewis’ Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

6282.o: Maggran Earthbinder in Sun Rock Retreat wants you to slay 7 Bloodfury Harpies, 7 Bloodfury Ambushers, 7 Bloodfury Slayers and 7 Bloodfury Roguefeathers.

6283.o: Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat wishes you to slay Bloodfury Ripper and bring her remains as proof of your deed.

6284.o: Kill Besseleth and bring Besseleth’s Fang to Maggran at Sun Rock Retreat.

6285.o: Buy a gryphon ride to Sentinel Hill from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric’s Crate to Lewis at Sentinel Hill.

6301.o: Tammra Windfield at Sun Rock Retreat wants you to gather 10 Gaea Seeds.

6321.o: Bring Podrig’s Order to Karos Razok.

6322.o: Bring Gordon’s Crate to Michael Garrett.

6323.o: Buy a bat ride to the Undercity from the bat master Karos Razok, then take Podrig’s Order to Gordon Wendham in the Undercity.

6324.o: Buy a bat ride to the Sepulcher from the bat master Michael Garrett, then bring Gordon’s Crate to Deathguard Podrig in the Sepulcher.

6342.o: Ride a hippogryph to Auberdine from the hippogryph master Vesprystus, then bring Nessa’s Collection to Laird.

6343.o: Bring Laird’s Response to Nessa Shadowsong.

6361.o: Bring the Bundle of Hides to the wind rider master Devrak in the Crossroads.

6362.o: Buy a wind rider to Thunder Bluff from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring the Bundle of Hides to Ahanu in Thunder Bluff.

6363.o: Bring Ahanu’s Leather Goods to Tal in Thunder Bluff.

6364.o: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Tal, then bring Ahanu’s Leather Goods to Jahan Hawkwing.

6365.o: Bring Zargh’s Meats to Devrak in the Crossroads.

6381.o: Plant 10 Gaea Seeds in Gaea Dirt Mounds, and then return the remaining Enchanted Gaea Seeds to Tammra at Sun Rock Retreat.

6382.o: Speak with Senani Thunderheart at Splintertree Post, Ashenvale.

6384.o: Buy a wind rider to Orgrimmar from the wind rider master Devrak, then bring Zargh’s Meats to Gryshka in Orgrimmar.

6385.o: Bring Gryshka’s Letter to Doras in Orgrimmar.

6386.o: Buy a wind rider to the Crossroads from the wind rider master Doras, then bring Gryshka’s Letter to Zargh at the Crossroads.

6387.o: Bring Brock’s List to Thorgrum Borrelson in Thelsamar.

6388.o: Bring the Honorary Picks to Gryth Thurden in Ironforge.

6389.o: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Nathaniel Dumah at Chillwind Camp in Western Plaguelands.

6390.o: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6391.o: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock’s List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.o: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6393.o: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.o: Bring Thazz’ril’s Pick to Foreman Thazz’ril.

6395.o: Bring Samuel Fipps’ Remains to Marla’s Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.
